info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Delete Loan By Param1-spec
info.description: The Loan Application Management API facilitates the deletion of specific loan applications based on unique identifiers. By targeting a loan application with the provided parameter, users can efficiently manage and remove records from the system. This API is typically utilized by financial institutions and management systems involved in loan processing, allowing for streamlined adjustments to loan application data. Ensure that adequate permissions are in place to maintain data integrity and compliance.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to delete a loan application identified by its unique resource ID. Ensuring that the loan application is no longer accessible and will be permanently removed from the system.

requestBody.description: Request body for deleting a loan application identified by its unique identifier. Please ensure to provide the necessary information as per the schema.

DeleteLoanByParam1Request.description: This schema represents the request body for deleting a loan application. It accepts a string value indicating the specific details of the loan application to be deleted.
